decision.summary: Static source proves that the present-tense RUNNING predicate is evaluated before all historical W1 integrity and coverage gates, so a clean post-window STOPPED snapshot can be historically admissible in principle yet fail the current census. The actual snapshot status, transition time and reason remain unknown; W1 quality was not evaluated. Conclusion: STATUS_MISMATCH_REQUIRES_BOUNDED_METADATA_PROOF.
allowed_claims: The census checks current collector status before frozen-day manifests, poll chains, coverage, or both-venue validity.
RUNNING, SOURCE_REVIEW, STOPPED, INITIALIZED, and a stale RUNNING state are statically reachable under distinct lifecycle paths.
A current RUNNING status is not itself a historical integrity predicate for closed W1 days.
The prior result disclosed only a status mismatch; actual status/cause and W1 quality remain unknown.
All original dates, thresholds, firewalls, manifest bindings, chain rules, and source-gap treatment remain frozen.
forbidden_reuse: Do not claim W1 source-quality PASS or infer opportunity/event rates.
Do not treat a post-window stop as proven without exact lifecycle metadata.
Do not retry the consumed bundle or open poll/event/fee/price/PnL bodies.
Do not patch or waive the RUNNING predicate from this static diagnosis.
Do not change the W1 window, denominator, 99% thresholds, chain checks, or source-gap rules.
Do not advance to price/outcome work.
decision.next_allowed_action: Independent Strategy Manager review; if justified, obtain one separately authorized exact T3 metadata-only lifecycle receipt with zero body access and zero collector mutation/restart, then decide whether a prospective contract change merits a new task.
